name: Paludal-Seif
description: Silence has shape here: boulder fields, shattered scarps, knife-edge shadows, and far to the east, massive canyon systems. Nothing wears any of it smooth.
In the calm seasons the world feels almost kind, which veterans say is exactly when it takes the careless.
ancient alien ruins still shows toolmarks half-finished. Whatever called everyone away did not give them time to say goodbye.
For traders, aluminum alone justifies the crossing; for everyone else, the planet pays in questions. Fuel is cheap, information is not, and both are dangerous to carry.
